description:
Chorus is an end-user collaboration library via 3-way xml merging and hg dvcs under the hood.

This package provides the Mercurial implementation that Chorus uses.
releaseNotes:
v3.0.2: explicitly request Python 2 on Linux

v3.0.3: Allow specifying an alternate destination directory using `Mercurial4ChorusDestDir`

v6.5.1: Upgrade to Mercurial 6.5.1

v7.0.1: Upgrade to Mercurial 7.0.1 and remove requirement to depend directly on this package (just depend on Chorus or LibChorus)

v7.0.2: Ship the Mercurial payload outside the runtimes/ convention path so an RID-specific `dotnet publish` no longer double-ships it (fixes NETSDK1152; consumers no longer need `ExcludeAssets="native"`)
